title: Engineering Abaxent
summaryLead: A fast, framework-free site for a network of technology professionals.
story: Abaxent is a Wisconsin technology brokerage with 22 years of vendor relationships and WBE, MBE, SBE and DBE certifications. Its model is unusual: it represents the buyer, not the vendor. The old site did little to explain that. They came to us to make the idea easy to grasp and to give prospects a direct line to the leadership team. We built a fast, accessible site around one question, what is a technology broker, then walked visitors through how brokering works, the impact it has, past projects and credentials.

features.title: Scroll-driven video hero
features.text: The film grows from an inset frame to full-bleed as you scroll. It pauses for reduced motion.
